meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测蛋白质与小分子的结合构象
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是从事药物设计或结构生物学的科研人员
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a researcher in drug design or structural biology

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用扩散模型预测小分子配体在蛋白上的三维结合姿势,输出多个按置信度排序的 SDF 文件,并分析置信度高低、汇总统计与导出 CSV。它只预测姿势与置信度,不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当用户说“对接这个配体”“预测结合姿势/结合位点”“虚拟筛选”等,并给出蛋白质(PDB 文件或序列)和配体(SMILES/SDF/MOL2)时触发。

say.text: 把这个 SMILES 和蛋白 PDB 做对接,输出前 5 个姿势。
say.note: 会生成按置信度排序的多个 pose 文件。

say.text: 批量对接这个 CSV 里的配体,并把置信度低的筛掉。
say.note: 会走批量流程并输出汇总 CSV。

say.text: 解释一下结果里 rank1_confidence0.87.sdf 的置信度。
say.note: 会读取结果文件并说明置信度范围。

howto.what_en: Claude uses a diffusion model to predict 3D binding poses of a small-molecule ligand on a protein, writing ranked SDF pose files with confidence scores and producing confidence summaries/CSV exports. It predicts poses and confidence, not binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to dock a ligand, predict a binding pose/site, or run virtual screening, and provides a protein (PDB file or sequence) plus a ligand (SMILES/SDF/MOL2).

say_en.text: Dock this SMILES into this PDB and output the top 5 poses.
say_en.note: Generates ranked pose files with confidence scores.

say_en.text: Run batch docking on this CSV and filter out low-confidence hits.
say_en.note: Uses batch workflow and exports a summary CSV.
Reads the result and interprets the confidence range.
